fact: The World Bank mission of 8-12 September 2025 found a contracted systems integrator starting work with INIC and the registry directorate to design and implement the new digital ID, and INIC and the directorate asked that local technicians be involved in programming from the start so they can maintain the systems later.
title: Projecto São Tomé e Príncipe Digital (P177158): Ajuda Memória, Missão de Apoio a Implementação, 8 a 12 de setembro de 2025
